text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Sant promises measures to cut tax evasion.
- Malta's second biggest trade union, UHM, calls for tax minimum for self-employed.
- Labour government will help self-employed, Sant promises.
- Nationalist Party starts fund-raising for own television station.
- Nationalist Party blasts report by government-appointed architect on work done so far on new hospital, on which building was begun by Nationalist administration.
